findings.detail: Description of "finish_token_signin" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Private data: tokenlock_info, check_token_access, start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Public sink: finish_token_signin · Destructive: tokenlock_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Private data: tokenlock_info, check_token_access, start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Public sink: finish_token_signin · Destructive: tokenlock_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
